senses.gloss: निवात- + कवच निवात- + कवच, (wearing an impenetrable coat of mail), m. a class of demons, Arj. 5, 10.
निवपन नि-वप् + अन, n. An offering to the Manes, Śāk. d. 152.

निवर्तक निवर्तक, i. e. नि-वृत्, Caus., + अक, adj., f. तिका.
 1. Turning back, flying, Hariv. 5048.
 2. Causing to cease, removing, Bhāṣāp. 136.

निवर्तन निवर्तन, i. e. नि-वृत् + अन,
 I. adj. Disappearing, MBh. 6, 2427.
 II. n.
 1. Return, Rām. 6, 92, 4.
 2. Ceasing, MBh. 1, 8388.
 3. Abstaining from (abl.), 1, 373.
 4. Inactivity, Kām. Nītis. 1, 28.
 5. Bringing back, Amar. 84.
 6. Turning off from (abl.), Vedāntas. in Chr. 203, 15.

निवर्तिन् निवर्तिन्, i. e. नि-वृत् + इन्, adj., f. नी.
 1. Turning back, Rām. 2, 105, 29.
 2. Flying, showing the heels, 1, 6, 20.
 3. Returning, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 788.
 4. Leaving, MBh. 13, 2653.
 5. Abstaining from, 12, 10386.
 6. Allowing to return, Hariv. 4836.
निवर्हण निवर्हण, see निबर्हण.

निवसन नि-वस् + अन, n.
 1. Putting on, Rām. 2, 37, 13 Gorr.
 2. Cloth, Ragh. 19, 41.

निवासन निवासन, i. e. नि-वस् + अन, n.
 1. Sojourn, Rām. 1, 3, 10 Gorr.
 2. Passing (as time), 1, 3, 18 Gorr.
निवह नि-वह् + अ, m. A multitude, Pañc. v. d. 8.

निवात नि-वात,
 I. adj., f. ता, Protected against the wind, not windy, Hariv. 3947.
 II. n.
 1. A place inaccessible to the wind, MBh. 2, 1218.
 2. Calm, Kumāras. 3, 48.
 III. m. An impenetrable coat of mail.

निवाप निवाप, i. e. नि-वप् + अ, m.
 1. Seed, corn, MBh. 13, 4350.
 2. Offering to the Manes, 12, 6996.
निवापक निवापक, i. e. नि-वप् + अक् m. A sower, Rām. 2, 90, 20 Gorr.
निवारक निवारक, i. e. नि-वृ + अक, adj. Able to keep off, MBh. 8, 1276.

निवारण निवारण, i. e. नि-वृ + अन,
 I. adj. Keeping off, MBh. 3, 12454.
 II. n.
 1. Keeping off, Rām. 2, 23, 40.
 2. Preventing, MBh. 2, 2002.
 3. Prohibition, Bhāg. P. 1, 5, 45.
निवास् निवास्, i. 10 (rather a denomin. derived from निवास), Par. To put on.

निवास निवास, i. e. नि-वस् + अ, m.
 1. Dwelling, Rām. 3, 5, 22.
 2. Passing the night, Hariv. 9700.
 3. An abode, a house, Bhāg. P. 1, 11, 27.
 4. Nightquarters, Rām. 2, 55, 33.
 5. Cloth, Hariv. 10679.
 --Comp.

निवासिन् निवासिन्, i. e. नि-वस् + इन्,
 I. adj.
 1. Dwelling, Rām. 1, 9, 36.
 2. निवास + इन्, Latter part of comp. adj. Clothed, covered, MBh. 7, 9532.
 II. n. An inhabitant, Man. 5, 11.

निविड निविड, probably नि-विल,
 I. adj., f. डा.
 1. Without interstices, Mālav. d. 24.
 2. Dense, Bhāg. P. 5, 2, 4.
 3. Firm, Kathās. 5, 140.
 II. m. The name of a mountain, MBh. 6, 140.
निवीतिन् निवीतिन्, i. e. नि-वीत + इन् (vb. व्ये), adj. Wearing the sacred cord fastened on one's neck, Man. 2, 63.

निवृत्ति नि-वृत् + ति, f.
 1. Return, MBh. 5, 7469.
 2. Disappearance, 6, 5775.
 3. Cessation, Śāk. 112, 16.
 4. Abstinence, Man. 5, 56.
 5. Abstaining from acting, inactivity, Bhag. 16, 7; Bhāṣāp. 148.

निवेदन निवेदन, i. e. नि-विद्, Caus., + अन,
 I. adj. Announcing, Hariv. 9289. []
 II. n.
 1. Making known, Sāv. 3, 5.
 2. Announcement, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 417.
 3. Offering, MBh. 2, 1361.
निवेदयिषु निवेदयिषु, i. e. नि-वेदयिष (desider. of the Caus. of विद्, without reduplication), + उ, adj. Wishing to report (acc.), MBh. 3, 1543.
निवेदिन् निवेदिन्, i. e. नि-विद्, Caus., + इन्, adj., f. नी, Reporting, announcing, Rām. 1, 70, 5 Gorr.; Varāh. Bṛh. S. 85, 58.

निवेश निवेश, i. e. नि-विश् + अ, m.
 1. Settling, Hariv. 3520.
 2. Encamping, 4999.
 3. A residence, MBh. 1, 7781.
 4. A camp, 5, 173.
 5. Marriage, 1, 1051.
 6. Foundation, Rām. 1, 34, 5.
 7. Impression, mark, Śāk. d. 142, v. r.

निवेशन निवेशन, i. e. नि-विश् + अन,
 I. adj. Entering, Hariv. 15005.
 II. m. A proper name, 9195.
 III. n.
 1. Sitting down, Rām. 6, 85.
 2. Encamping, MBh. 14, 1901.
 3. Marriage, Bhāg. P. 3, 7, 31.
 4. A dwelling-place, a residence, Indr. 3, 2.
 5. A camp, MBh. 5, 680.
 --Comp.
निवेशवन्त् निवेश + वन्त्, adj. Lying on, Kumāras. 7, 7.

निवेशिन् निवेशिन्, i. e. निवेश + इन्, adj., f. नी.
 1. Lying near, Kathās. 25, 74.
 2. Being in, Vikr. d. 41.
† नीव् नीव्, i. 1, Par. To become corpulent.

नीवार नीवार,
 I. m. Rice growing wild, Rām. 2, 28, 21 Gorr.
 II. f. रा, The name of a river, MBh. 6, 328.

नीवि and नीवी नीवी̆, f. A cloth worn round a woman's waist, Yājñ. 2, 284.
 --Comp.
